description: This file defines the SugarFieldCurrency class, which extends SugarFieldFloat to handle currency-specific display and import sanitization in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for rendering list view formatting, sanitizing imported data, and formatting currency fields according to locale and user preferences.

classes.name: SugarFieldCurrency
classes.description: A class that extends SugarFieldFloat to implement currency display and processing features within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getListViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates the display for currency fields in list views, handling currency conversions based on user preferences and locale.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes currency input values during import, removing currency symbols and grouping separators, and respecting field length constraints.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats a raw currency value according to locale and system preferences, for display purposes.
